purpose: Sixth-pass official and first-party source verification for five still-open Batch-51 identity, occupation or current-status conflicts while the same V53 task remains queued for clean remote-HEAD browser acceptance. No second runner, task, checkpoint advancement, exact-parcel promotion or parcel-value publication is performed.

method.official_source_policy: Only primary auction pages, first-party operator pages, Companies House records, official destination or branch pages and local-authority routes are promoted. Third-party directories and review sites are not promoted.
method.current_activity_policy: An active company or registered office does not prove an open trading site, lease continuation or legal completion. An explicit first-party closure notice overrides generic opening-time text on the same site.
method.parcel_binding_policy: NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED until exact title or canonical geometry is read.

rows.address: 15-19 High Street, Earls Colne, Essex, CO6 2PA
rows.resolved_fact: The primary auction record identifies East of England Co-operative Society Limited as head tenant and states that the convenience store was sublet. East of England Co-op's current store page identifies its Earls Colne foodstore at 37 High Street, while Post Office's current branch page identifies Earls Colne Post Office at 52 High Street. Neither first-party route supports a current operating site at the subject 15-19 High Street address, so the current subtenant remains unidentified.

rows.address: Lloyds Chambers, The Square, Barnstaple, Devon, EX32 8LS
rows.resolved_fact: The Acuitus record names the dissolved SCOFFS ORIGINAL LIMITED as historical restaurant tenant. Companies House continues to record the controlling person of D SCOFF'S LTD at 1 The Square, Barnstaple, EX32 8LS, and North Devon Council maintains the official planning-search route. This reinforces a replacement-company nexus at the exact square address but still does not prove occupation of the restaurant demise in Lloyds Chambers or a lease assignment.
